correction_reason.description: V4675A pins an exact successor Git blob that is not retrievable as a repository object. A deterministic reconstruction from the immutable V4674A correction authorization produces a different exact blob, so implementation must fail closed until that reachable replacement is explicitly authorized.

replacement_semantics: load immutable V4674A correction authorization alongside V4673A authorization
require the V4674A superseded authorization path and exact blob identity
require exactly one corrected mapping for each V4673A target path and matching source identity
accept only exact V4673A source, exact historical V4673A successor, or exact V4674A replacement successor for each guard target
reject missing mapping, wildcard, dynamic-current-state, partial, mixed or unknown identity
change exactly the V4673A regression test in a later separate implementation slice
after that successor is merged, retry the exact V4674A two-guard implementation as a separate slice
